authorization: Pending owner review (2026-10-29). Planning only: nothing is live or verified. The production apply still needs its own owner approval and staging acceptance.
notes: Owner report 2026-10-29: a check filed from a homeowner's pre-claim upload link moves through Review and Endorsing, but the homeowner's link stays in pre-claim mode, so the homeowner never sees the claim timeline, the check, signature requests or later updates. fileHomeownerUploadToReview files the check with the upload's claim (null for a pre-claim link) and never ties the link to a claim afterwards. The owner chose (2026-10-29, Option 1) to block leaving Review without a claim and to tie the link when the check moves on. The accepted workflow.mjs bytes, in handleCheckTransition, for start_endorsing, route_loss_draft and mark_ready_for_deposit only: look up the homeowner_ledger_check_uploads row whose attached_check_id is the check (same tenant); if one exists and the check has no claim, refuse with 409 homeowner_upload_needs_claim ('Link this check to a claim first so the homeowner can follow it.') before any write; otherwise, after the status update and audit row and in the same transaction, when the upload has no claim yet and the claim belongs to the check's tenant: set the upload's claim_id, set homeowner_ledger_tokens.claim_id where the token is the upload's, in the same tenant, and still has no claim (a link on another claim is never moved), and insert one homeowner_upload_attached ledger event, mirroring handleHomeownerLedgerAttachUpload in homeowner.mjs. Checks without a homeowner upload are unchanged. The tables and columns are the ones homeowner.mjs already reads and writes in production through the same role; no SQL change. workflow.mjs live_sha256 0a8d1218 is the bytes the cash-jobs check-link production apply recorded (previous_manifest); no workflow.mjs change has been planned or applied since. sql_before stays SQL 121. A read-only production overlay inspect must confirm the live member before any apply.
